arxiv-2108-05643.description: Abstract . The realization function of a shallow ReLU network is a continuous and piecewise affine function f : ℝ d → ℝ f:{\mathbb{R}}^{d}\to{\mathbb{R}} , where the domain ℝ d {\mathbb{R}}^{d} is partitioned by a set of n n hyperplanes into cells on which f f is affine.

arxiv-2206-15427.title: Few-Shot Cross-Lingual TTS Using Transferable Phoneme Embedding
arxiv-2206-15427.creator: Wei-Ping Huang, Po-Chun Chen, Sung-Feng Huang, Hung-yi Lee
arxiv-2206-15427.description: Abstract This paper studies a transferable phoneme embedding framework that aims to deal with the cross-lingual text-to-speech (TTS) problem under the few-shot setting. Transfer learning is a common approach when it comes to few-shot learning since training from scratch on few-shot training data is bound to overfit.

arxiv-2301-02708.title: Few-shot Node Classification with Extremely Weak Supervision Conference: Proceedings of the Sixteenth ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining; February 27-March 3, 2023; Singapore, Singapore Proceedings of the Sixteenth ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining (W
arxiv-2301-02708.creator: Song Wang, Yushun Dong, Kaize Ding, Chen Chen, Jundong Li
arxiv-2301-02708.description: Abstract . Few-shot node classification aims at classifying nodes with limited labeled nodes as references. Recent few-shot node classification methods typically learn from classes with abundant labeled nodes (i.e., meta-training classes) and then generalize to classes with limited labeled nodes (i.e., meta-test classes). Nevertheless, on real-world graphs, it is usually difficult to obtain abundant labeled nodes for many classes.

arxiv-2409-03748.title: A neural processing approach to quantum state discrimination
arxiv-2409-03748.creator: Saeed A. Khan, Fangjun Hu, Gerasimos Angelatos, Michael Hatridge, Hakan E. Türeci
arxiv-2409-03748.description: Abstract Although linear quantum amplification has proven essential to the processing of weak quantum signals, extracting higher-order quantum features such as correlations in principle demands nonlinear operations. However, nonlinear processing of quantum signals is often associated with non-idealities and excess noise, and absent a general framework to harness nonlinearity, such regimes are typically avoided.

arxiv-2502-03294.description: Abstract . arxiv-2504-17598.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zheng Wei, Jing Xing, Yida Gu, Wenjing Huang, Dong Dai, Guangming Tan, Dingwen Tao. Compared to replication-based storage systems, erasure-coded storage incurs significantly higher overhead during data updates. To address this issue, various parity logging methods have been proposed. Nevertheless, due to the long update path and substantial amount of random I/O involved in erasure code update processes, the resulting long latency and low throughput often fail to meet the requirements of high performance applications.

arxiv-2509-22843.creator: Rob A. J. Eyles-Ferris, Andrew King, Rhaana L. C. Starling, Peter G. Jonker, Andrew J. Levan, Antonio Martin-Carrillo, Tanmoy Laskar, Jillian C. Rastinejad, Nikhil Sarin, Nial R. Tanvir, Benjamin P. Gompertz, Nusrin Habeeb, Paul T. O’Brien, Massimiliano De Pasquale
arxiv-2509-22843.description: Abstract GRB 250702B is a unique astrophysical transient characterised by its nature as a repeating gamma-ray trigger. Its properties include possible periodicity in its gamma-ray light curve, an X-ray counterpart that rose prior to the gamma-ray outbursts and faded quickly, and radio and infrared counterparts.

pmc-10573158.title: The Effect of Latent Tuberculosis Infection on Ovarian Reserve and Pregnancy Outcomes among Infertile Women Undergoing Intrauterine Insemination: A Retrospective Cohort Study with Propensity Score Matching
pmc-10573158.creator: Yifan Chu, Ying Chen, Wen Yao, Luyao Wang, Bo Zhang, Lei Jin, Jing Yue, Giuseppe Ricci, Ferdinando Antonio Gulino
pmc-10573158.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Latent tuberculosis infection (LTBI) widely exists in patients with unexplained infertility, and whether LTBI would affect the ovarian reserve and pregnancy outcome of infertile women undergoing intrauterine insemination (IUI) is still unknown. A single-center, retrospective, cohort study was designed that included infertile women undergoing IUI at the Department of Reproductive Medicine, Tongji Hospital, Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology in Wuhan, China, from January 2018 to December 2020.

pmc-11349750.title: Poorer representation of minds underpins less accurate mental state inference for out-groups
pmc-11349750.creator: Bryony Payne, Geoffrey Bird, Caroline Catmur
pmc-11349750.description: Societies are becoming more polarised, driven in part by misconceptions about out-groups’ beliefs. To understand these effects, one must examine the cognitive processes underlying how people think about others. Here, we investigate whether people are less prone to theorise about the minds of out-groups, or less able to do so.

pmc-12586761.title: Harnessing 50 years of tick population genetics: Choosing the right molecular tool for contemporary research
pmc-12586761.creator: Xavier Barton, Joseph B Fontaine, Shanan S Tobe, Charlotte L Oskam
pmc-12586761.description: Ticks are ectoparasites of major medical, veterinary and ecological importance, transmitting a wide range of pathogens to humans, companion animals and livestock. Understanding the population structure of ticks is essential for uncovering patterns of pathogen transmission, and population genetics provides a powerful method for this purpose.

pmc-13250164.title: Applying LIBS, SEM/EDX, and FTIR spectroscopic analysis for the conservation of cairene architectural heritage
pmc-13250164.creator: Raghda Hosny El-Saeid, Anwer Mahran, Mona F Ali, Mohamed Abdel-Harith
pmc-13250164.description: This study investigates the wall paintings of Al-Qazdughli Palace, an early twentieth-century landmark in Cairo’s historic Garden City district near Simon Bolivar Square, using a multi-analytical spectrochemical approach. As an important example of Cairo’s architectural heritage, the palace has experienced extended neglect and significant deterioration.

pmc-13282974.title: Date Fruits and Their Products for Almond Beverage Fortification: Assessment of Beverages and Resulting Residues
pmc-13282974.creator: Malek Ben Zid, Nesrine Rokbeni, Nouha M’hiri, Moncef Chouaibi, Nahla Zghonda, Nourhene Boudhrioua
pmc-13282974.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SUMMARYResearch backgroundThe shift towards plant-based beverages, particularly almond drinks, has increased the need to develop innovative products using fruits and herbal extracts to improve their nutritional and sensory properties. In this study, date palm fruits, Deglet Nour variety (tamr stage) and Besser Helou variety (khalal stage), and two Deglet Nour-derived products (date powder and syrup) were evaluated as fortifying ingredients in almond drinks.

pmc-13395256.title: A Digital Acceptance and Commitment Therapy and Education Intervention for Caregivers of Very Preterm Infants in the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit: Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13395256.creator: Kristin Harrison Ginsberg, Jane Alsweiler, Jenny Rogers, Alana Cavadino, Meihana Douglas, Anna Serlachius
pmc-13395256.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-13487001.title: Rotation of microtextured anatomical breast implants: A retrospective series of 134 reconstructions
pmc-13487001.creator: Tarik Ihrai, Alice Roosen, Dominique Lanvin, Philippe Giordano
pmc-13487001.description: BackgroundAnatomically shaped breast implants are widely used in implant-based breast reconstruction because of their ability to restore breast contour and projection. Following regulatory restrictions on macrotextured implants, microtextured anatomical implants have emerged as an alternative. However, concerns remain regarding their positional stability, particularly the risk of implant rotation.
